description:
Install any app on Samsung Tizen devices — TVs, projectors and smart monitors

Cross-platform desktop installer that side-loads any app onto Samsung Smart TVs, projectors and smart monitors running Tizen OS — Jellyfin, Moonlight, Moonfin, Litefin and a community catalog, or your own WGT package. Handles device discovery, Tizen certificates and installation. Successor to Jellyfin2Samsung.Jellyfin2Samsung.
📦 v3.3.1 - 2026-11-17
🚀 New features
- Back up signing certificates automatically (desktop, CLI, phone) (#1070)
- Update all on desktop, phone and CLI (#1072)
- Install links: apps2samsung:// in Core and the CLI (#1066) (#1073)
- Catalog: say so when schemaVersion is newer than this build knows (#1077)
- Install links: open them in the desktop app (#1066) (#1075)
- Install links: open them in the phone app (#1066) (#1076)
- Restore a TV: TV profiles in Core and the CLI (#1069) (#1085)
- Restore a TV: the desktop screens and saved app lists per TV (#1069) (#1086)
- Restore a TV on the phone (#1069) (#1087)
- Restore a TV: saved lists in the backup zip, and the CLI menu (#1069) (#1090)
- Phone TV list: a Needs attention group that says why (#1079) (#1094)

- fix(desktop): status line follows an install from a file to the end (#1100) (#1101)
